name: Quálitas Controladora, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Quálitas Controladora, S.A.B. de C.V., through its subsidiaries, provides insurance, coinsurance, and reinsurance services in the accidents and illnesses, damages, health, and automobile areas in Mexico, the United States, El Salvador, Peru, and Costa Rica. The company offers personal cars and pickups, cargo pickups, trucks, public passenger service, border and regularized, tourists, motorcycles, and standardized basic insurance products, as well as professional liability insurance for insurance agents. It also provides foreign liability and compulsory vehicle civil liability insurance products. In addition, the company is involved in acquisition and rental of real estate; acquisition, sale,…
